notes:
What's new in 3.6.0:
- Fixed: human characters were sometimes generated as animals. A character described without an obvious keyword (e.g. "Ola, 28, freckles, works in a bakery") fell into the non-human template and came back as an animal. Characters now default to human, and only become a creature/robot/object when the description actually says so - a dragon is still a dragon.
- New: the app now asks what medium your film is - live action, 2D animation or 3D animation - and generates your assets in that medium. Until now every character, location and product sheet was rendered photoreal, no matter what the script or the style step said.
- The AI reads the medium from your script and preselects it, but only when it is genuinely sure. If the script could go either way, nothing is preselected and it asks you to choose instead of guessing.
- Your medium also sets the default frame style, and picking a style yourself always wins over it.
